verdict.rationale: Puzzle has an API for embedded accounting and AI-driven close/categorization features, plus manual journal entry editing that auto-creates reversing entries, suggesting some support for draft/post workflows, but there's no direct evidence of an agent-driven API workflow for drafting journal entries into a dedicated 'review queue' for an accountant. missing for 10: explicit API endpoints for creating draft journal entries via agent, a documented review-queue/approval workflow for accountant sign-off, and confirmation that AI-drafted entries route to a human-in-the-loop review state before posting.
